narrationTexts: Both bugs confirmed. Fixing `options.js` first (accepts `retryCount`, falls back to `retries`), then run the build to hit the second bug.
finalText:
**Build's clean.** Exit `0`, `0 errors`.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

1. [src/core/options.js](src/core/options.js) — read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`.
2. [src/net/retryPolicy.js](src/net/retryPolicy.js) — treated an unset `backoffEnabled` as invalid. New config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`, so it threw.

Remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from the dependency bump (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, `punycode`, etc), not build blockers.

Next: nothing.
